comparison.objective: Detect and reverse a backwards anti-runback dog, versus tune and lock an adjustable damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Inspect orientation, grasp, remove or rotate, and reinstall a directional pawl versus hex-key unlocking, fine collar adjustment, counterholding, and torque-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Correct dog orientation is title/body-implied; the body only says the task path and supplies no specs, latch checks, or thresholds. Candidate requires two safe impact cycles and retained setting.
comparison.reason: Although both include rotation, correcting a discrete component orientation tests assembly diagnosis/reorientation rather than continuous damping calibration.
